scope: Completed Qwen3.5-9B Pro C=128 rollout-only observations; two-host source is preceding sweep.

definitions.window: model_ready_at through finished_at; no training updates in these runs.
definitions.requests: Client begin/end interval overlap: mean and peak per ten-second bin. Includes gateway/network waits; does not measure engine-running or queued requests.
definitions.gpu: Ten-second sample means across recorded GPUs; missing samples omitted, not zero-filled.
definitions.tokens: Output tokens assigned to client completion time, divided by bin duration; delivered output, not instantaneous engine generation.
definitions.cpu_and_vms: Full-node-coverage one-minute means wholly inside the rollout window; CPU normalized to the active fleet capacity.
